+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);
+  for(const shot of ['image-editor-draw','image-editor-save','campaigns-page']){
+    check(source.includes('/Images/help/'+shot+(locale==='en'?'':'.'+locale)+'.webp'),'Wrong capture '+shot+' '+locale);
+  }
+  const schemas=html.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').map(s=>JSON.parse(s.textContent));
+  const article=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='Article');
+  const faq=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='FAQPage');
+  check(article?.datePublished==='2026-10-22','Wrong publish date '+locale);
+  check(faq?.mainEntity?.length===6,'Wrong FAQ count '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelectorAll('main table').length===2,'Wrong table count '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('The words are the hard part of localizing a visual.'),'Untranslated opening '+locale);
+  const indexRoute=locale==='fr'?'fr/ressources/guides-pratiques':locale==='zh'?'zh/resources/how-to':'resources/how-to';
+  const index=parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,indexRoute,'index.html'),'utf8'));
+  check(index.querySelector('a.feat')?.getAttribute('href')===route,'Guide not featured '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: ${h1}; canonical, language alternates, hero, three localized captures, two tables, six FAQ entries, date and featured listing verified`);
+}
+for(const [locale,feed] of [['en','resources/rss.xml'],['fr','fr/ressources/rss.xml'],['zh','zh/resources/rss.xml']]){
+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+}
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');
+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('Three resource feeds and three sitemap URLs verified.');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args)=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'});
+const files=git(['diff','--name-only','--','src/i18n/dict']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+let retained=0;
+for(const file of files){
+  const original=git(['show','HEAD:'+file]);
+  const old=JSON.parse(original), current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(release,file),'utf8'));
+  const same=Object.keys(old).length===Object.keys(current).length&&Object.entries(old).every(([k,v])=>current[k]===v);
+  if(same){fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release,file),original);continue;}
+  const ordered={};
+  for(const k of Object.keys(old))if(k in current)ordered[k]=current[k];
+  for(const k of Object.keys(current))if(!(k in ordered))ordered[k]=current[k];
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release,file),JSON.stringify(ordered,null,2)+'\n');
+  retained++;
+}
+console.log(`Removed ordering-only dictionary churn; ${retained} existing dictionaries have semantic changes.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});

+  }

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const {parse} = require('node-html-parser');
+const base = path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release','.vercel/output/static');
+const slug = 'localize-visual-for-markets';
+const routes = [
+  ['en',`/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+  ['fr','/fr/ressources/guides-pratiques/adapter-un-visuel-a-plusieurs-marches'],
+  ['zh',`/zh/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+];
+const check = (condition,message) => {if (!condition) throw new Error(message);};
+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);
+  for(const shot of ['image-editor-draw','image-editor-save','campaigns-page']){
+    check(source.includes('/Images/help/'+shot+(locale==='en'?'':'.'+locale)+'.webp'),'Wrong capture '+shot+' '+locale);
+  }
+  const schemas=html.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').map(s=>JSON.parse(s.textContent));
+  const article=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='Article');
+  const faq=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='FAQPage');
+  check(article?.datePublished==='2026-10-22','Wrong publish date '+locale);
+  check(faq?.mainEntity?.length===6,'Wrong FAQ count '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelectorAll('main table').length===2,'Wrong table count '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('The words are the hard part of localizing a visual.'),'Untranslated opening '+locale);
+  const indexRoute=locale==='fr'?'fr/ressources/guides-pratiques':locale==='zh'?'zh/resources/how-to':'resources/how-to';
+  const index=parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,indexRoute,'index.html'),'utf8'));
+  check(index.querySelector('a.feat')?.getAttribute('href')===route,'Guide not featured '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: ${h1}; canonical, language alternates, hero, three localized captures, two tables, six FAQ entries, date and featured listing verified`);
+}
+for(const [locale,feed] of [['en','resources/rss.xml'],['fr','fr/ressources/rss.xml'],['zh','zh/resources/rss.xml']]){
+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+}
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');
+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('Three resource feeds and three sitemap URLs verified.');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const {parse} = require('node-html-parser');
+const base = path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release','.vercel/output/static');
+const slug = 'localize-visual-for-markets';
+const routes = [
+  ['en',`/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+  ['fr','/fr/ressources/guides-pratiques/adapter-un-visuel-a-plusieurs-marches'],
+  ['zh',`/zh/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+];
+const check = (condition,message) => {if (!condition) throw new Error(message);};
+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);
+  for(const shot of ['image-editor-draw','image-editor-save','campaigns-page']){
+    check(source.includes('/Images/help/'+shot+(locale==='en'?'':'.'+locale)+'.webp'),'Wrong capture '+shot+' '+locale);
+  }
+  const schemas=html.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').map(s=>JSON.parse(s.textContent));
+  const article=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='Article');
+  const faq=schemas.find(s=>s['@type']==='FAQPage');
+  check(article?.datePublished==='2026-10-22','Wrong publish date '+locale);
+  check(faq?.mainEntity?.length===6,'Wrong FAQ count '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelectorAll('main table').length===2,'Wrong table count '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('The words are the hard part of localizing a visual.'),'Untranslated opening '+locale);
+  const indexRoute=locale==='fr'?'fr/ressources/guides-pratiques':locale==='zh'?'zh/resources/how-to':'resources/how-to';
+  const index=parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,indexRoute,'index.html'),'utf8'));
+  check(index.querySelector('a.feat')?.getAttribute('href')===route,'Guide not featured '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: ${h1}; canonical, language alternates, hero, three localized captures, two tables, six FAQ entries, date and featured listing verified`);
+}
+for(const [locale,feed] of [['en','resources/rss.xml'],['fr','fr/ressources/rss.xml'],['zh','zh/resources/rss.xml']]){
+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+}
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');
+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('Three resource feeds and three sitemap URLs verified.');

+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { readdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

import sitemap from '@astrojs/sitemap';

import { alternates, pageId, resolvePath } from './src/i18n/paths';

const SITE = 'https://www.hubstudio.ai';

/**
 * Site-relative path of a sitemap URL, trailing slash dropped (root stays '/').
 * @param {string} url
 * @returns {string}
 */
function toPath(url) {
  const p = new URL(url).pathname;
  return p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/') ? p.slice(0, -1) : p;
}

/**
 * Absolute URL for a site-relative path, in the trailing-slash-free form
 * @astrojs/sitemap emits for <loc> (the home page is the bare domain).
 * @param {string} path
 * @returns {string}
 */
function absolute(path) {
  return path === '/' ? SITE : SITE + path;
}

/** @type {Map<string, string>} Last commit ISO date per file tracked under src/. */
const gitDateCache = new Map();
let gitDatesLoaded = false;

/**
 * Last commit date (ISO 8601) per file under src/, newest commit wins. One
 * `git log` call, memoized for the build. Stays empty when git history is not
 * reachable (shallow clone, zip download): affected pages then ship no
 * <lastmod>, which is correct, an absent date beats an invented one.
 * @returns {Map<string, string>}
 */
function gitDates() {
  if (gitDatesLoaded) return gitDateCache;
  gitDatesLoaded = true;
  try {
    const log = execSync('git log --name-only --format=%x00%cI -- src', {
      encoding: 'utf8',
      maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
    });
    let date = '';
    for (const line of log.split('\n')) {
      if (line.startsWith('\0')) {
        date = line.slice(1).trim();
      } else if (line && date && !gitDateCache.has(line)) {
        gitDateCache.set(line, date);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // No git history reachable; every page simply omits <lastmod>.
  }
  return gitDateCache;
}

/**
 * Source files whose change history defines a page's <lastmod>: the page file
 * itself, plus the data file for data-driven routes. Shared layouts and CSS
 * are deliberately excluded, a layout tweak is not a content change and must
 * not bump every URL's date at once.
 * @param {string} path  Site-relative path, e.g. '/', '/contact', '/work/x'.
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
function sourceFiles(path) {
  const rel = path === '/' ? 'index' : path.replace(/^\//, '');

  const direct = `src/pages/${rel}.astro`;
  if (existsSync(direct)) return [direct];

  const index = `src/pages/${rel}/index.astro`;
  if (existsSync(index)) return [index];

import { dirname, isAbsolute, relative as relativePath, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { copyFilesToFolder } from "@astrojs/internal-helpers/fs";
import { appendForwardSlash } from "@astrojs/internal-helpers/path";
import { searchForWorkspaceRoot } from "./searchRoot.js";
function findCommonAncestor(rootPath, entryPath) {
  let ancestor = rootPath;
  let relativeEntryPath = relativePath(ancestor, entryPath);
  while (relativeEntryPath === ".." || relativeEntryPath.startsWith(`..${sep}`) || isAbsolute(relativeEntryPath)) {
    const parent = dirname(ancestor);
    if (parent === ancestor) break;
    ancestor = parent;
    relativeEntryPath = relativePath(ancestor, entryPath);
  }
  return ancestor;
}
async function copyDependenciesToFunction({
  entry,
  outDir,
  includeFiles,
  excludeFiles,
  logger,
  root
}, cache) {
  const entryPath = fileURLToPath(entry);
  logger.info(`Bundling function ${relativePath(fileURLToPath(outDir), entryPath)}`);
  const searchStart = findCommonAncestor(fileURLToPath(root), entryPath);
  const base = pathToFileURL(appendForwardSlash(searchForWorkspaceRoot(searchStart)));
  const { nodeFileTrace } = await import("@vercel/nft");
  const result = await nodeFileTrace([entryPath], {
    base: fileURLToPath(base),
    cache
  });
  for (const error of result.warnings) {
    if (error.message.startsWith("Failed to resolve dependency")) {
      const [, module, file] = /Cannot find module '(.+?)' loaded from (.+)/.exec(error.message);
      if (module === "@astrojs/") continue;
      if (module === "sharp") continue;
      if (entryPath === file) {
        logger.debug(
          `[@astrojs/vercel] The module "${module}" couldn't be resolved. This may not be a problem, but it's worth checking.`
        );
      } else {
        logger.debug(
          `[@astrojs/vercel] The module "${module}" inside the file "${file}" couldn't be resolved. This may not be a problem, but it's worth checking.`
        );
      }
    } else if (error.message.startsWith("Failed to parse")) {
      continue;
    } else {
      throw error;
    }
  }
  const commonAncestor = await copyFilesToFolder(
    [...result.fileList].map((file) => new URL(file, base)).concat(includeFiles),
    outDir,
    excludeFiles
  );
  return {
    // serverEntry location inside the outDir
    handler: relativePath(commonAncestor, entryPath)
  };
}
export {
  copyDependenciesToFunction,
  findCommonAncestor
};

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){

+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+  retained++;
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+  check(article?.datePublished==='2026-10-22','Wrong publish date '+locale);
+  check(faq?.mainEntity?.length===6,'Wrong FAQ count '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelectorAll('main table').length===2,'Wrong table count '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('The words are the hard part of localizing a visual.'),'Untranslated opening '+locale);

+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){

+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args)=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'});
+const files=git(['diff','--name-only','--','src/i18n/dict']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+let retained=0;
+for(const file of files){
+  const original=git(['show','HEAD:'+file]);
+  const old=JSON.parse(original), current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(release,file),'utf8'));
+  const same=Object.keys(old).length===Object.keys(current).length&&Object.entries(old).every(([k,v])=>current[k]===v);
+  if(same){fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release,file),original);continue;}
+  const ordered={};
+  for(const k of Object.keys(old))if(k in current)ordered[k]=current[k];
+  for(const k of Object.keys(current))if(!(k in ordered))ordered[k]=current[k];
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release,file),JSON.stringify(ordered,null,2)+'\n');
+  retained++;
+}
+console.log(`Removed ordering-only dictionary churn; ${retained} existing dictionaries have semantic changes.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){

+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');

+  }

+  }

+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);

+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=git(['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard'],release).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);

+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');

+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');

+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}

+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){

+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }

+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');

+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));

+    exact++;continue;

+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');

+  }
+}

+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){

+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});

+    continue;

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }

+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');

+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){

+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');

+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }

+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){

+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});

+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
