+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}

+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');

+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));
+console.log('Main staged tree matches validated release: '+mainTree);
+console.log(git(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);

+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');

+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){

+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});

+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const git=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',['-c','core.safecrlf=false',...args],{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Main index is not empty');
+if(git(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==git(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Release and main bases differ');
+const files=[...new Set((git(['diff','HEAD','--name-only'],release)+'\n'+git(['ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],release)).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean))];
+const baseFiles=new Set(git(['ls-tree','-r','--name-only','HEAD']).trim().split('\n'));
+for(const file of files){
+  const from=path.join(release,file),to=path.join(root,file);
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/runs/'))continue;
+  if(file.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')&&baseFiles.has(file)){
+    const base=JSON.parse(git(['show','HEAD:'+file]));
+    const next=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(from,'utf8'));
+    const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(to,'utf8'));
+    let changed=false;
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(next)){
+      if(base[key]===value)continue;
+      if(current[key]&&current[key]!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Concurrent translation conflict in '+file+': '+key);
+      if(current[key]!==value){current[key]=value;changed=true;}
+    }
+    for(const key of Object.keys(base)){
+      if(!(key in next)&&current[key]===base[key]){delete current[key];changed=true;}
+    }
+    if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(to,JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(file==='src/i18n/routes.ts'||file.startsWith('src/i18n/glossary/')){
+    const patch=git(['diff','HEAD','--binary','--full-index','--',file],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    try {git(['apply','--reverse','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});continue;}catch{}
+    git(['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    git(['apply','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+    continue;
+  }
+  if(baseFiles.has(file)&&!file.startsWith('editorial/')){
+    const baseline=git(['show','HEAD:'+file],root,{encoding:'buffer'});
+    const current=fs.readFileSync(to);
+    if(current.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')!==baseline.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')&&!current.equals(fs.readFileSync(from)))throw Error('Unexpected existing source change: '+file);
+  }
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(to),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(from,to);
+}
+git(['add','--',...files],release);
+git(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=git(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+git(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const mainTree=git(['write-tree']).trim(),releaseTree=git(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(mainTree!==releaseTree)throw Error('Release and main staged trees differ');
+const changedFiles=git(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),JSON.stringify({tree:mainTree,files:changedFiles},null,2));

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-release');
+const baseline=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-baseline');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,'files.json'),'utf8'));
+const staged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-22-staged.json'),'utf8'));
+const touched=new Set(staged.files);
+let exact=0,dicts=0;
+for(const f of files){
+  const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(baseline,f));
+  const now=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,f));
+  if(!touched.has(f)){
+    if(!before.equals(now))throw Error('Unrelated file changed: '+f);
+    exact++;continue;
+  }
+  if(f.startsWith('src/i18n/dict/')){
+    const base=JSON.parse(cp.execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:'+f],{cwd:release,encoding:'utf8'}));
+    const prior=JSON.parse(before),current=JSON.parse(now);
+    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(prior)){
+      if(value!==base[key]&&current[key]!==value)throw Error('Existing translation altered: '+f+': '+key);
+    }
+    dicts++;
+  }
+  if(f==='src/i18n/routes.ts'){
+    const restored=now.toString('utf8').replace(/^.*'localize-visual-for-markets'.*\r?\n/m,'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
+    if(restored!==before.toString('utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n'))throw Error('Unrelated route changes were altered');
+  }
+}
+console.log(`${exact} unrelated files preserved byte-for-byte; prior edits in ${dicts} shared dictionaries and the route map preserved.`);
